howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会修改后端 MDF 代理的请求验证、超时处理或前后端所有权，确保浏览器不直接调用外部 MDF 服务。
howto.when: 当需要更改后端 MDF 代理、请求验证、超时处理或 MDF 转换的前后端所有权时触发。

say.text: 修改 MDF 代理的超时时间
say.note: Claude 会调整后端超时设置。

say.text: 增加请求文本长度验证
say.note: Claude 会在代理前添加验证逻辑。

say.text: 确保前端调用后端代理而非外部服务
say.note: Claude 会检查并修正调用路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will modify the backend MDF proxy's request validation, timeout handling, or frontend/backend ownership, ensuring the browser does not call the external MDF service directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when changing the backend MDF proxy, request validation, timeout handling, or frontend/backend ownership for MDF conversion.

say_en.note: Claude will adjust backend timeout settings.
Claude will add validation logic before proxying.

say_en.text: Ensure frontend calls backend proxy, not external service
say_en.note: Claude will check and fix the call path.
